result.Method of Attack: Malicious archive or image files containing LNK shortcut files disguised as PDFs that download and execute remote payloads including XWorm RAT and AsyncRAT variants via PowerShell and VBScript chains
result.Attack Vector: Malicious email attachments or links leading to manual extraction and execution of LNK files
Indicators of Compromise: SHA2 hashes of malicious LNK, HTA, VBS, PS1, WSF, GIF files
Malicious URLs such as datacenter002.myftp.biz, datacenter11.myftp.org, 179.43.175.187, nulled2nd.camdvr.org
Creation of suspicious users (e.g., 'System32' user with password '123')
Disabling and tampering with Windows Defender and Firewall
Files like note.hta, note.gif, wed.hta, TCywxTOvZk.wsf, no.txt, j.png, py.ps1, x.ps1, Microsoft.bat
